definition: Counterexample status carried by the original normal support>8 family-chain source-form witness.
absorption_target_condition: absorption trigger may or may not be present
status_effect: source status is the object to preserve, refute, reduce, or escape
failure_effect: status is routed to named blocker if source form is not recognized
caveat: Does not assert source refutation without target alignment.

definition: Status of the bounded family-chain target produced from the absorption trigger.
source_condition: trigger recognized and target layer selected
absorption_target_condition: target belongs to pair52 through high57 fresh package
status_effect: target status can be checked against bounded family-chain theorem
failure_effect: applicability blocker if target cannot be validated
caveat: Lower-layer freshness proves availability, not arbitrary applicability.

definition: Target/source status is closed by contradiction when the bounded theorem applies to the same obstruction payload.
source_condition: source payload/status aligns with target theorem input

definition: Residual branch status is reduced only when absorption output is normalized and strictly smaller.
caveat: No smaller-witness claim without strict decrease.

definition: Failure of trigger, target validity, theorem applicability, payload/status alignment, or measure decrease is named.
source_condition: operation precondition or proof branch fails
caveat: Escape is classification, not theorem completion.

definition: Bounded family-chain theorem refutes a valid target object.
absorption_target_condition: fresh target object with aligned payload
caveat: Applicability and source refutation are distinct.

definition: Runtime self-verification supports current target package identity.
source_condition: source trigger selects current target object
absorption_target_condition: object appears in self-verified lower-layer package
failure_effect: target identity proof for arbitrary trigger
caveat: Self-verification is package consistency, not status proof.

definition: Seven lower family-chain layers are fresh and imported count is zero.
caveat: Does not imply arbitrary family-chain absorption proof.

definition: Strict decrease needed for residual smaller-witness branch.
caveat: Contradiction branch does not require smaller witness.

definition: Source-to-target or source-to-residual payload relation needed for status transfer.
Absorption output must not violate canonical normal form or motif compression contracts.
caveat: Separate from canonical motif compression operation.

definition: Unresolved residuals remain deferred higher-support candidates after operation proofs close.
